entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I think I need to return something? I bought these cycling shoes, and I'm just so confused by everything on the website.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number VF789012.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order for the Aero-Vent cycling shoes, delivered 15 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't know. A technical fault? I don't think so. I tried them on one ride and they just... hurt. I got terrible blisters on my heels, and I couldn't get the cleats in a comfortable position. I read all the guides, but it's all so overwhelming. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Sarah. I'm sorry to hear they caused blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Finding the right fit for cycling shoes can be tricky. Let me just pull up our return policy for you.
Okay, thank you. I tried looking but I just got lost.

No problem at all. Let's see... Okay, according to my system, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, as long as the item is in its original condition. Since you received them 15 days ago, you are well within that window.
Oh, really? So I can get a refund? That's such a relief!

Absolutely. I can start the return process right now and email you a pre-paid shipping label. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method. The refund should appear in your account within 3-5 business days after that.
Wow, thank you so much, David. You've made this so much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and watch for that email with the return label. Goodbye.
